P1.note: P1 re-gate: gold = the labellers' agreed acceptable set (contains A); stratum 1 decides: V-sem accuracy on the answered items >= the R_assign minimum, abstention <= the GO cap g, B1 and B2 <= the rev-12 baseline bar over all eligible items; strata 2-3 and the path-following rates are reported; UNMEASURED below 20 eligible stratum-1 items

P2.note: P2 re-gate: gold = the clone's own blind label on catalogue-p2 (gap or new; the rev-12 derived gold is reported in derived_vs_direct, never scored); over the direct-label positives V-sem's `none` rate on the answered positives >= the new-area gate bound and abstention <= the GO cap g; UNMEASURED below 8 positives (does not pass: one shot)

note: one shot (PREREGISTRATION 5, rev 13): a P1 or P2 that is not PASS stops the pilot; the rev-12 round-0 gates.json is never rewritten
